definition: De-identified participant code
derivation: Study code assigned at release; no name, contact detail, collection date or laboratory identifier is retained
coding_notes: P01 to P30; each code appears once per design, four records in total

definition: Held-out fold of that participant in the five-fold participant-grouped cross-validation
derivation: Fixed partition used for every reported metric; listed in participant_fold.csv
coding_notes: Integer 1 to 5; six participants per fold; 24 held-out records and 96 training records per fold

definition: Backpack design worn in the record
derivation: Four 30 L square designs, each loaded with 2.5 kg in addition to its own mass; parameters in SI S2
coding_notes: Bpk1 to Bpk4; enters the models as four indicator columns

definition: Peak force transmitted through the strap-shoulder interface under the controlled impulse test
derivation: Analogue peak-hold tension gauge in series with the strap; 1.25 kg mass lifted 5 cm and released; mean of ten releases (Section 2.3.1)
coding_notes: Constant within a design and identical for every participant

definition: Modelled compressive force at the L4/L5 segment during level walking with the loaded backpack
derivation: Siemens Tecnomatix Jack 8.01; participant-specific manikin; two consecutive gait cycles (Section 2.3.2)
coding_notes: Varies with the manikin of the participant and with the design; supports Table 5

variable: the different of The pressure at lumbar L4/L5 and no load
definition: Increment of the modelled L4/L5 force over the unloaded condition
derivation: Difference between the loaded and the unloaded simulation of the same manikin
coding_notes: Collinear with the absolute force by construction

variable: The MF of the trapezius before use
definition: Median frequency of the trapezius surface EMG, recorded in the 5 min before the 10 min walking trial
derivation: Welch power spectral density, 2048-point Hann window, 50 % overlap, 0.5 Hz resolution; lowest frequency bin reaching 50 % of cumulative power (Section 2.3.3)
coding_notes: A downward shift indicates a shift of the spectrum towards lower frequencies

variable: The %RVC of the trapezius before use
definition: Amplitude of the trapezius surface EMG normalised to the participant- and muscle-specific reference, recorded in the 5 min before the 10 min walking trial
derivation: RMS of the band-pass filtered signal (10-400 Hz, 50 Hz notch) divided by the highest RMS across all 100 ms windows of all walking conditions of that participant and muscle (Section 2.3.3)
coding_notes: Reference voluntary contraction, not a percentage of maximal voluntary contraction

variable: The MF of the trapezius after use
definition: Median frequency of the trapezius surface EMG, recorded in the 5 min after the 10 min walking trial

variable: the different of the trapezius MF between use and after
definition: Post-use minus pre-use change of the trapezius median frequency
derivation: Arithmetic difference of the two corresponding columns
coding_notes: Negative value indicates a downward shift

variable: the different of the trapezius %RVC between use and after
definition: Post-use minus pre-use change of the trapezius normalised amplitude
derivation: Arithmetic difference of the two corresponding columns
coding_notes: Positive value indicates higher activation after use
